title: 'consumer-session/create' asks for the session's stream, and an engine that names none is polled for nothing.
why: behavioural spec 'execute': 'create' carries 'events': true, and the SDK drains the stream only when the answer names one (engine-protocol spec §9.6, staged plan S3.5). This engine's 'create' answers with a session alone, as one that predates the stream would, so the SDK sends exactly what it sent before.
note: How many polls a closure's run makes depends on how long it runs, so no case counts them when the engine does name a stream; live/exchange-events-logged checks what the SDK does with the events.
